e|that's a good point.name: that's a good point
e|that's a good point.gloss: 정말 좋은 지적이에요, 그런 식으로 생각해 본 적이 없었어요.
e|that's a good point.after: , I never thought about it that way before.
e|that's a good point.why: 상대 말이 일리 있다는 말은 That's a good point예요.
e|that's a good point.line: That's a good point, I never thought about it that way before.

e|on the other hand.name: on the other hand
e|on the other hand.gloss: 나는 도시에서 사는 것이 좋지만, 한편 시골은 훨씬 조용해.
e|on the other hand.before: I like living in the city, but
e|on the other hand.why: 다른 면을 이어 말할 때는 on the other hand를 써요.
e|on the other hand.line: I like living in the city, but on the other hand, the countryside is much quieter.

e|to be fair.name: to be fair
e|to be fair.gloss: 공정하게 말하면, 오늘 아침에 늦게 시작했어요.
e|to be fair.after: , we did get a late start this morning.
e|to be fair.why: 공평하게 인정한다는 말은 To be fair예요.
e|to be fair.line: To be fair, we did get a late start this morning.

e|having said that.name: having said that
e|having said that.gloss: 나는 매운 음식을 별로 좋아하지 않지만, 가끔은 고추를 조금 즐긴다.
e|having said that.before: I’m not a big fan of spicy food;
e|having said that.after: , I do like a little bit of chili now and then.
e|having said that.why: 앞에서 한 말을 두고 반대로 넘길 때는 having said that을 써요.
e|having said that.line: I’m not a big fan of spicy food; having said that, I do like a little bit of chili now and then.

e|it's up to you.name: it's up to you
e|it's up to you.gloss: 영화를 볼지 게임을 할지 네가 선택해.
e|it's up to you.before: We can watch a movie or play a game,
e|it's up to you.why: 결정은 상대에게 달렸다는 말은 it's up to you예요.
e|it's up to you.line: We can watch a movie or play a game, it's up to you.

e|make a decision.name: make a decision
e|make a decision.gloss: 두 선택지가 모두 좋아 보여서 결정하기가 어렵다.
e|make a decision.why: 여러 가지 중에서 하나를 고른다는 말은 make a decision이에요.
e|make a decision.line: It's hard to make a decision when both options seem good.

e|take into account.name: take into account
e|take into account.gloss: 우리가 무엇을 할지 정하기 전에 날씨도 고려해야 해.
e|take into account.after: the weather before making any plans.
e|take into account.why: 그 점도 고려한다는 말은 take into account예요.
e|take into account.line: We should take into account the weather before making any plans.

e|come up with.name: come up with
e|come up with.gloss: 친구 생일 선물로 뭘 할지 생각해야 해.
e|come up with.after: a gift for my friend's birthday.
e|come up with.why: 아이디어를 생각해 낸다는 말은 come up with예요.
e|come up with.line: I need to come up with a gift for my friend's birthday.

e|in the long run.name: in the long run
e|in the long run.gloss: 매달 조금씩 저축하면 시간이 지나면 도움이 돼요.
e|in the long run.before: If you save a little money every month, it pays off
e|in the long run.why: 긴 시간이 지난 뒤를 말할 때는 in the long run을 써요.
e|in the long run.line: If you save a little money every month, it pays off in the long run.

e|when it comes to.name: when it comes to
e|when it comes to.gloss: 요리에 관해서라면, 우리 가족 중에서 내 여동생이 최고야.
e|when it comes to.after: cooking, my sister is the best in our family.
e|when it comes to.why: 특정 주제로 좁혀 말할 때는 When it comes to를 써요.
e|when it comes to.line: When it comes to cooking, my sister is the best in our family.

e|no way.name: no way
e|no way.gloss: 너 혼자서 그 큰 피자를 다 먹었다니 믿을 수 없어.
e|no way.after: , you finished that huge pizza by yourself?
e|no way.line: No way, you finished that huge pizza by yourself?

e|it must have been.name: it must have been
e|it must have been.gloss: 혼자서 새로운 도시로 이사하는 것은 아마 힘들었을 거예요.
e|it must have been.after: difficult to move to a new city alone.
e|it must have been.why: 단서로 과거를 추측할 때는 It must have been을 써요.
e|it must have been.line: It must have been difficult to move to a new city alone.

e|should have known.name: should have known
e|should have known.gloss: 아무도 오지 않았을 때 회의가 취소된 걸 알아챘어야 했어요.
e|should have known.after: the meeting was canceled when nobody showed up.
e|should have known.why: 그때 이미 알았어야 했다는 말은 should have known이에요.
e|should have known.line: I should have known the meeting was canceled when nobody showed up.

e|you might be right.name: you might be right
e|you might be right.gloss: 곧 날씨가 변할 거라는 네 말이 맞을 수도 있어.
e|you might be right.why: 상대 말이 맞을 수도 있다는 말은 You might be right예요.
e|you might be right.line: You might be right about the weather changing soon.

e|it's not worth it.name: it's not worth it
e|it's not worth it.gloss: 나는 논쟁하고 싶었지만, 솔직히 그럴 가치가 없어.
e|it's not worth it.before: I wanted to argue, but honestly,
e|it's not worth it.why: 애쓸 가치가 없다는 말은 it's not worth it이에요.
e|it's not worth it.line: I wanted to argue, but honestly, it's not worth it.

e|as long as.name: as long as
e|as long as.gloss: 내일까지 돌려준다면 내 자전거를 빌릴 수 있어.
e|as long as.after: you bring it back by tomorrow.
e|as long as.why: 그 조건이면 괜찮다는 말은 as long as예요.
e|as long as.line: You can borrow my bike as long as you bring it back by tomorrow.

e|whether or not.name: whether or not
e|whether or not.gloss: 회의에 올 수 있는지 없는지 알려 주세요.
e|whether or not.after: you can come to the meeting.
e|whether or not.why: 가능한지 아닌지를 물을 때는 whether or not을 써요.
e|whether or not.line: Let me know whether or not you can come to the meeting.

e|to some extent.name: to some extent
e|to some extent.gloss: 나는 네 말에 어느 정도 동의하지만, 나도 다른 의견이 있어.
e|to some extent.after: , but I have a different opinion too.
e|to some extent.why: 어느 정도까지는 그렇다는 말은 to some extent예요.
e|to some extent.line: I agree with you to some extent, but I have a different opinion too.

e|a tight deadline.name: a tight deadline
e|a tight deadline.gloss: 우리는 시간이 거의 없으니 집중해서 이 일을 끝내자.
e|a tight deadline.after: , so let’s focus and get this done.
e|a tight deadline.why: 시간이 매우 빠듯한 마감은 a tight deadline이에요.
e|a tight deadline.line: We’re working under a tight deadline, so let’s focus and get this done.

e|meet halfway.name: meet halfway
e|meet halfway.why: 서로 양보해 맞춘다는 말은 meet halfway예요.
e|meet halfway.line: Can we meet halfway on the price?

e|it's hard to say.name: it's hard to say
e|it's hard to say.gloss: 우리가 제시간에 끝낼 수 있을지 확실하지 않다.
e|it's hard to say.why: 쉽게 단정하기 어렵다는 말은 It's hard to say예요.
e|it's hard to say.line: It's hard to say if we'll finish on time.

e|out of the question.name: out of the question
e|out of the question.before: Going out in this storm is
e|out of the question.why: 절대 불가능하다는 말은 out of the question이에요.
e|out of the question.line: Going out in this storm is out of the question.
